tools.name: powershell
tools.targetPath: git --no-pager status --short; if (Test-Path ./assets -PathType Container) { Write-Output 'ASSETS_EXISTS' } else { Write-Output 'ASSETS_MISSING' }

tools.name: powershell
tools.targetPath: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path ./assets -Force | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path ./assets -PathType Container)) { throw 'Failed to create assets directory' }

tools.name: powershell
tools.targetPath: $temp = Join-Path $env:TEMP "taskforge-empty-$([guid]::NewGuid()).json"; try { $output = & $PSHOME/pwsh -NoProfile -File ./src/TaskForge.ps1 due --on-or-before 2026-07-29 --data-file $temp --json 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw ($output -join "`n") }; if (($output -join "`n") -ne '[]') { throw "Expected [], got: $output" }; 'PASS: empty JSON due report' } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

tools.name: task_complete
